children: Innventure forfeited 435,168 earnout shares tied to Milestone One after DarkNX deployment issues.
Board and holders agreed to voluntary forfeiture of 435,168 common shares issued for Milestone One.
Forfeitures executed via Forfeiture Agreements dated August 24, 2026 and canceled by transfer agent Sept 8–15, 2026.
Milestone One was originally deemed achieved based on a DarkNX purchase order exceeding $15.0M in revenue.
DarkNX later informed Accelsius the referenced deployment site is unavailable; project removed from Accelsius’ 2026 forecast.
Forfeiture was voluntary and not an admission that Milestone One was unmet; Independent Committee’s milestone determination remains final.
